_comment: Single source of truth for the 7-model parse-anything OCR sweep on an L4. Each entry drives BOTH the runner and the shim (prompt + extra_body + max_tokens). backend=vllm_docker -> `docker run <vllm_image> --model <id> <serve_args>`; backend=custom_docker -> `docker build -f <dockerfile>` then run <docker_run_cmd> (Unlimited-OCR = native_wrapper.py; Nemotron-Parse = vLLM+extras). Prompts/versions verbatim from model cards (2026-07 research). NOTE: the Nanonets prompt stores checkbox glyphs as ASCII sentinels {U2610}/{U2611}; the shim restores chr(0x2610)/chr(0x2611) before sending.

models.notes: GLM family, native glm_ocr arch. Fits L4 trivially.

models.prompt: Extract the text from the above document as if you were reading it naturally. Return the tables in html format. Return the equations in LaTeX representation. If there is an image in the document and image caption is not present, add a small description of the image inside the tag; otherwise, add the image caption inside . Watermarks should be wrapped in brackets. Ex: OFFICIAL COPY. Page numbers should be wrapped in brackets. Ex: 14 or 9/22. Prefer using {U2610} and {U2611} for check boxes.
models.notes: Stock Qwen2.5-VL arch. PINNED to v0.11.2: vllm-openai:latest produced '!' garbage (Qwen2.5-VL regression); v0.11.2 works (same image as olmOCR). {U2610}/{U2611}=checkbox glyphs.

Needs upstream vllm with native deepseek_ocr. Model context capped at 8192; keep --max-model-len 8192 and max_tokens 4096 so (vision tokens + output) fits (larger max_tokens -> HTTP 400). Hardcodes GUNDAM mode.

models.prompt:
Attached is one page of a document that you must process. Just return the plain text representation of this document as if you were reading it naturally. Convert equations to LateX and tables to HTML.
If there are any figures or charts, label them with the following markdown syntax ![Alt text describing the contents of the figure](page_startx_starty_width_height.png)
Return your output as markdown, with a front matter section on top specifying values for the primary_language, is_rotation_valid, rotation_correction, is_table, and is_diagram parameters.
models.notes: FP8 W8A8 auto-detected; L4 (sm89) supports it natively. Do NOT pass --quantization. olmocr renders pages at longest-dim 1288.

models.prompt:
OCR this image to HTML, arranged as layout blocks.  Each layout block should be a div with the data-bbox attribute representing the bounding box of the block in x0 y0 x1 y1 format.  Bboxes are normalized 0-1000. The data-label attribute is the label for the block.

Use the following labels:
- Caption / Footnote / Equation-Block / List-Group / Page-Header / Page-Footer / Image / Section-Header / Table / Text / Complex-Block / Code-Block / Form / Table-Of-Contents / Figure / Chemical-Block / Diagram / Bibliography / Blank-Page
models.notes: Needs vllm 0.17.0 (qwen3_5 arch). Outputs HTML -> post-convert to markdown. Chandra client normally does this; we capture raw HTML + convert in report.

(a) per-page via Baidu's OFFICIAL vLLM image. PROMPT MUST start with '<image>' (verified: 'document parsing.' alone -> empty output; '<image>document parsing.' -> grounded OCR). vLLM loads a FALLBACK chat template (none on HF Hub) so the explicit <image> in the text is what places the image. (card: vllm/vllm-openai:unlimited-ocr [CUDA13] / :unlimited-ocr-cu129 [CUDA12.9, matches our VM]). The ORIGINAL 'vLLM startup exit' was the GENERIC vllm-openai image; the official one bakes the arch in -> fast, intended path, fair throughput vs the other vLLM-served models. whole-doc (infer_multi) is NOT available via vLLM per the card, so ONLY the __multi entry stays native. VM smoke: if the image tag differs or output repetition-loops, adjust tag / add a no-repeat-ngram logits processor to serve_args.

(b/c) whole-doc path (native transformers infer_multi — the ONLY route for it; vLLM can't do multi-page per the card). prewarm sends ALL page PNGs in ONE request -> native_wrapper.model.infer_multi (32k ctx, eager attn — loads fine, no OOM). PROMPT MUST contain a SINGLE '<image>' token: infer_multi does formatted_prompt.split('<image>') and packs all page images at that one position (docstring example '<image>Multi page parsing.'); a prompt without it -> IndexError. infer_kwargs (image_size=1024 multi-page, no_repeat_ngram_size=35/ngram_window=1024) are the card's multi-page settings and are accepted verbatim by infer_multi's signature; no_repeat_ngram prevents DeepSeek-lineage repetition collapse.

ROOT CAUSE of the 0.066 run: MISSING the model's repetition-stop logits processor. Every page collapsed into a repetition loop (empty \multicolumn rows / a hallucinated LaTeX para repeated verbatim). The sampling params (temp0/top_k1/rep_penalty1.1) were ALREADY correct per the card; the fix is --logits-processors nemotron_parse_vllm_logitprocs:NemotronParseRepetitionStopLogitsProcessor (exact class name confirmed on VM; the model card's 'StopProcessor' was wrong). TRITON_ATTN dropped (card scopes it to A100/A10; L4 uses vLLM's default). The processor module ships in the repo's logitsprocs/ dir -> Dockerfile puts it on PYTHONPATH. 4-token prompt + skip_special_tokens=false stay. Earlier 'needs its own postprocessor' note was a mis-diagnosis (bbox coords are 1 token/page, already stripped by the scorer).

parse-anything's native paddle backend. Serves on vllm latest (trust_remote_code). NOTE: vLLM /v1 is ELEMENT-level recognition; full-page markdown needs the official paddleocr doc_parser layout pipeline. Here run single-shot 'OCR:' on the full page -> underrepresents its structured/pipeline mode.
